newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan's March index of leading indicators rises.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's March index of leading indicators rises.

text.p: Taiwan's index of leading business indicators, which forecasts peaks and troughs in the business cycle, rose for the seventh consecutive month in March, a cabinet agency said on Monday.
The index rose 1.1 percent in March from February to 104.2, the cabinet's Council for Economic Planning and Development said in a statement.
The index of coincident indicators all rose in March, gaining 1.6 percent to 103.3 from a month ago, it said.
